text:
lauren_ae: Quick sync — ACME wants three things for the POC: hosted API keys + audit evidence, option to stream logs into their Splunk (or drop to S3), and a pricing estimate if they want a short Dedicated trial. Also security questionnaire asks how we rotate keys.

claire_acme: Correct. Splunk HEC is preferred but we can accept S3. Must show 90-day retention and be able to prove keys used for the demo were ephemeral. Also they asked whether logs contain full prompts.

devon_se: For Hosted: we can issue scoped ephemeral keys (default 2h) — can reduce to 30m for demos. Hosted audit exports include auth events, API key ids, timestamps, actor, request metadata (model, tokens), but do NOT contain raw prompt text by default. We can optionally include a request_hash field (sha256) per request if they want verification without revealing content.

security_lead: Confirmed. Our compliance posture: we do not include customer prompt payloads in the standard audit bundle. If customer requests verifiable linkage, we provide a manifest with per-record request_hash and a bundle-level signature (signed by redwood-ops) so they can verify integrity.

pricing_bot: Pricing note: Dedicated short trials can be offered as a time-limited reserved pool. Typical POC uplift pricing: we can grant a 30% one-time POC credit for first month on Dedicated; exact quote depends on pool size.

lauren_ae: Claire — would ACME prefer we do: A) Hosted + S3 daily exports (fast), or B) Dedicated trial with direct HEC stream (more work but real-time)? Also confirm retention 90 days.

claire_acme: S3 daily exports OK for now, long-term they'd prefer HEC. Confirm retention 90 days. Also they want a short one-pager describing each log field for their security team.

devon_se: Sample CSV schema (one-line header + example line) you can paste to their SIEM team:

header: timestamp,event_type,key_id,actor,ip,user_agent,model,tokens_in,tokens_out,request_hash
example: 2026-03-22T14:01:12Z,auth,demo-01,cli,203.0.113.12,curl/7.88.1,n/a,0,0,
2026-03-22T14:01:18Z,generation,demo-01,cli,203.0.113.12,curl/7.88.1,redwood-v1,10,45,3b9f3c8d...

devon_se: Example curl to fetch signed S3 export (signed URL valid 24h):

curl -L "https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-poc-exports/acme-bundle-2026-03-22.csv?X-Amz-Signature=..." -o acme-poc.csv

security_lead: We'll produce a short answer for the questionnaire: hosted export = metadata only (no prompts), ephemeral demo keys rotate automatically and are logged, long-lived keys require admin approval and are audited. We'll attach the one-pager and the manifest example.

infra_ops_bot: log-export-job started for acme-poc-bucket at 2026-03-22T14:05:03Z (job id: export-1936-22).

lauren_ae: Action items: 1) Devon  produce one-pager + CSV schema + curl example (EOD). 2) Security_lead  draft questionnaire answers (tomorrow AM). 3) Pricing_bot  send preliminary Dedicated trial credit terms to Claire. 4) Claire  confirm S3 ingestion and sign-off on 90-day retention.

claire_acme: S3 ingestion confirmed. Please include a line that the signed bundle is only metadata and includes a signed manifest for integrity verification.

security_lead: Will include that exact sentence in the evidence doc.

lauren_ae: Thanks all  I'll follow up with the AE for next steps on Dedicated if they signal interest after the POC.

claire_acme: Great, appreciate the quick turnaround.
